_note: How many journeys are exempt, and when (D-100; rulebook SAL-LTA-BLOCK-001, -CARRY-001; DR 13 R-12): two in a block of four calendar years. TY 2026-27, Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.278(2) (p.1776): "two journeys performed in a block of four calendar years commencing from the calendar year 2022"; r.278(3)–(4): where a block is unused, the concession "first availed of … during first calendar year of the immediately succeeding block … shall be eligible" and is not counted against the two. TY 2025-26, Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.2B(2): "two journeys performed in a block of four calendar years commencing from the calendar year 1986" — the same boundaries (1986 + 36 = 2022) — and r.2B(3) with its Explanation, the same carry-over. Blocks are calendar years, so a tax year straddles two. In every regime as a row; the new regime forbids it through DIS-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION, whose basis REG-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION (S2 s.202(2)(a); 1961 s.115BAC(2)(i)) every explanation cites (D-166).
